title: add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v27
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Adds v27 profiling baselines and reporting DAG. Improves alignment between local profiling and production metrics; enables automated regression alerts for representative workloads.
description: Add v27 of benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline. This PR introduces representative workload runners for streaming text-generation and embeddings, updates profiling baselines (cold-start and steady-state) for A100 and RTX6000 targets, and wires results into the reporting pipeline for aggregation and alerting. Motivation: reduce drift between lab profiling and production inference metrics, provide reproducible baselines for upcoming quantized-runtime experiments, and enable nightly aggregation + regression alerting. High-level changes: 1) new runners under benchmark-lab/runners/ to capture realistic seq-len distributions and batching behavior; 2) profiling baseline configs under benchmark-lab/baselines/v27/ with metadata and threshold files; 3) reporting pipeline DAG and connector updates to publish aggregated metrics to BigQuery and trigger eval jobs; 4) CI job to run lightweight perf-smoke tests and publish artifacts; 5) docs and runbooks for oncall. Checklist: [x] add representative runners and unit tests, [x] add v27 baseline configs, [x] implement reporting DAG and connector, [x] add CI perf-smoke job, [x] update docs and runbook. Linked work: ENG-3572 (baseline rollout plan), ENG-3580 (reporting and alerts). This PR is scoped to the benchmark-lab component and is backward-compatible with prior baselines. Merge method: squash.

Add reporting DAG v27 and BigQuery connector; publish aggregated daily summaries and ingest raw profiling traces (benchmark-lab/reporting)
